St. Lucie · 2026-11-10 · Board of County Commissioners Regular Meeting (Board of County Commissioners): FY 2025-2026 St. Lucie County Sheriff's Office Statutory Budget - End-of-Year Amendment - ADD ON
item.description: The Sheriff requests approval of the FY 2025-2026 End-of-Year Amendment to the Sheriff's Statutory Budget. The amendment has been reconciled to actual year-end sources and uses and confirms no unexpended balances due to the BOCC under Section 30.50(6), Florida Statutes. No additional County funding is requested. Section 30.49(12), Florida Statutes, authorizes the Sheriff, following BOCC budget approval, to transfer appropriations among fund and functional categories and object and subobject codes. Sections 30.49(8) and 30.50(4), Florida Statutes, provide for amendments at the Sheriff's request and with BOCC approval, and Section 129.06(2), Florida Statutes, permits prior-year budget amendments during the first 60 days of the succeeding fiscal year. In short, this is a true-up.
